mapper.select: SELECT REPORT_ID, TITLE, CONTENT, REPORTER, RECEIVER, STATUS, REPORT_DT, CONFIRM_DT, OPINION FROM MEMO_REPORT WHERE REPORT_ID = #{reportId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEMO_REPORT ( REPORT_ID, TITLE, CONTENT, REPORTER, RECEIVER, STATUS, REPORT_DT ) VALUES ( #{reportId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{reporter}, #{receiver}, '보고', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE MEMO_REPORT SET STATUS = '확인', CONFIRM_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE REPORT_ID = #{reportId} AND STATUS IN ('보고', '의견')
UPDATE MEMO_REPORT SET STATUS = '의견', OPINION = #{opinion}, CONFIRM_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE REPORT_ID = #{reportId} AND STATUS IN ('보고', '확인')
